answer: Splitting into many identities multiplies the locked capital, and each fake persona must sustain those pulse costs indefinitely. Sybil resistance can work by tying each agent identity to a staked deposit plus a periodic proof-of-liveness pulse signed with a device key. Reward multipliers, like an opal graded by rarity, make one verified identity worth more than many hollow ones. Forgers also risk slashing and a lagoon-style reputation drift, so mass identity creation becomes economically irrational. From sa0023's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
